name: Tarragon
ability: Resin Coat / Sticky Hold / Liquid Ooze (hidden)
look: a sticky black tar wyvern with glossy dripping hide, drip-edged tar sheet wings and amber glowing eyes
entry: Born from the accumulated grime of industrial chimneys, Tarragon's heavy, tar-soaked wings make flight difficult, forcing it to crawl along cavern walls.
how: Wild: rare in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
Its ability Resin Coat halves damage from contact moves and slows the attacker.
